description: Thesis-driven dealflow sourcing & diligence agent (early-stage crypto / AI). Scrumban backlog. This file is the single source of truth for project status; the terminal CLI and the HTML board both read it.

items.title: Source-health panel: show every source live vs. skipped
criteria: Each run lists every configured source with state live / skipped / failed + reason.
A missing API key shows 'skipped (no key)' — never an error or stack trace.
Panel is visible in the UI and summarised in the Actions digest artifact.

subtasks.text: Build a source registry: source name -> required env var / key.
Add a per-source probe returning live / skipped / failed + reason.
Render a source-health panel on the Run / Digest page.
Add a source-health summary line to the digest artifact.
Unit test: missing key -> 'skipped', never raises.

items.title: Farcaster radar live via a Neynar API key
criteria: With NEYNAR_API_KEY set, each run fetches follows for accounts in smart_accounts.yaml.
Projects newly followed by >=2 trusted accounts are injected as scored candidates.
Without the key, the radar skips gracefully (no error).

subtasks.text: Add a Neynar client + register NEYNAR_API_KEY in the source registry.
Fetch the following list per trusted account; cache last snapshot to disk.
Diff current vs previous; find projects followed by >=2 accounts.
Map discovered accounts -> company candidates; feed into the scorer.
Handle pagination + rate limits; persist snapshot for next diff.
Test: no key -> skip; mocked key -> candidate injected.

items.title: Spike: confirm X/Twitter API access & rate limits for follow-graph diffing
criteria: Timeboxed research story — no production code required.
Produces a written go / no-go with the tier, rate limits, cost, and a recommended approach.
Updates the estimate for S-09 based on findings.

subtasks.text: Identify X API endpoints for 'following' lists + access tier required.
Check rate limits, monthly caps, and cost at our trusted-account volume.
Throwaway prototype: pull one account's following list.
Write go/no-go note + recommended design; re-estimate S-09.

items.title: Agent memo streams progress and times out gracefully
criteria: Memo generation streams step-by-step progress to the UI.
Per-step and overall timeouts; on timeout it returns a partial memo + clear status.
Never hangs the request; the no-fabrication guardrail holds on partial results.

subtasks.text: Wrap each agent step with a timeout; add an overall deadline.
Stream step events to the UI (SSE / websocket / polling).
On timeout or error, return the partial diligence trail + 'incomplete' status.
Preserve 'not found' refusal behaviour on partial runs.
Test: simulated slow step returns within the deadline.

items.title: Report precision, recall & lead-time on the backtest page
criteria: Backtest page shows precision, recall, and median lead-time (days).
The counts behind each number are visible.
The verdict banner (yellow/green) reflects the metrics honestly.

subtasks.text: Define the ground-truth schema (deal, date-known, has-public-data flag).
Compute precision / recall from surfaced vs known.
Compute lead-time = date-widely-known - date-surfaced.
Render metrics + counts; keep the honest verdict logic.
Validate against the current 3-deal set.

items.title: Expand the backtest ground-truth set to >=15 deals
criteria: >=15 past deals with first-public-signal date and widely-known date.
Each flagged for whether it had public data (vs warm-intro only).
Documented provenance; backtest runs on the full set.

subtasks.text: Source 15+ past early-stage crypto/AI deals with known outcomes.
Record first-public-signal + widely-known dates per deal.
Flag public-data vs warm-intro-only deals.
Store as a versioned dataset with provenance notes.
Re-run backtest; snapshot the baseline metrics.

items.title: Calibrate scoring weights against backtest outcomes
criteria: Weights tuned on a train split and validated on a held-out split.
No tuning to the whole set (guards against overfitting).
Before/after metrics recorded for both splits.

subtasks.text: Split ground truth into train / hold-out.
Search theme + source weights on the train split.
Validate on hold-out; report both to expose overfit.
Persist chosen weights in the thesis config with rationale.

items.title: Persist the diligence trail so memos are re-openable
criteria: Every memo + full trail is saved with timestamps.
Re-openable from a Memos view by company / run.
Survives a server restart.

subtasks.text: Choose storage (json / sqlite) for memo + trail + timestamps.
Save on memo completion, including partial runs.
Add a Memos list + detail view; link from the digest card.
Test: restart server -> memo still retrievable.

items.title: Wire Nansen on-chain data into scoring
criteria: With NANSEN_API_KEY, smart-money flow signals feed the scorer.
Absent the key, it is skipped via source-health.
The signal's contribution shows in the card score breakdown.

subtasks.text: Add a Nansen client + register the key.
Map endpoints -> signals (smart-money inflow, holder growth).
Feed signals into scoring; expose contribution in the breakdown.
Add caching + rate-limit; graceful skip.
Test with mocked responses.

items.title: Twitter/X network radar mirroring Farcaster
criteria: Implements the approach recommended by SPK-1 (blocked until the spike is done).
>=2 trusted-account new-follow rule injects candidates.
Merges/de-dups with Farcaster candidates; skips gracefully without access.

subtasks.text: Implement the X following-graph client per the spike.
Snapshot + diff following lists across runs.
>=2-account new-follow -> candidate injection.
Merge / de-dup with Farcaster candidates.
Rate-limit + backoff; graceful skip; tests.

items.title: Cost / latency cap on memo generation
criteria: A per-memo token / step budget is enforced.
When exceeded, it stops and returns a partial memo with the reason.
The cap is configurable.

subtasks.text: Add a token / step counter + configurable budget.
Enforce the cap; return partial + reason.
Surface cost / latency in the trail footer.
Test cap enforcement.

items.notes: Step+timeout budget already existed (SIGNAL_AGENT_MAX_STEPS/_STEP_TIMEOUT_S/_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_S); added tracking + a rendered footer (steps used/max, elapsed/cap, status) in agent._prepend_trail, surfaced via a new 'budget' key on the run_diligence(_events) result. Scoped down from a token-dollar budget per discussion with operator — time/step cap already bounds cost adequately.

items.title: Scheduled daily runs with a delivered digest
criteria: A daily scheduled run produces a digest delivered to email or Slack.
Delivery failures raise an alert.
The schedule is configurable.

subtasks.text: Add a scheduler (cron / Actions schedule).
Render the digest to an email / Slack payload.
Add the delivery integration + secret handling.
Add failure alerting.
Test a dry-run delivery.

items.notes: Built on the existing sourcing.yml (schedule was already scaffolded, commented out). Delivery: scripts/notify_slack.py (stdlib urllib, no new dep) posts top-N ranked candidates to SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL repo secret; missing secret -> skip (graceful-absence rule), a real delivery failure -> non-zero exit -> job fails -> GitHub's native failure notification is the alert (no second alerting system built). Schedule default 0 13 * * * UTC, change the cron string to retime. Offline check: evals/notify_slack_check.py, wired into evals.yml CI. Operator still needs to: create the Slack webhook and add it as a repo secret named SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

items.title: Persist run history for comparison over time
criteria: Each run's digest is stored with a timestamp.
A history view lists past runs and opens any digest.
A retention policy keeps storage bounded.

subtasks.text: Persist each digest with run metadata.
Add a history list + open-past-digest view.
Add a retention / cleanup policy.

items.title: Highlight new candidates and score changes since last run
criteria: The digest marks candidates new since the last run.
Score changes vs last run are shown.
A 'what changed' filter is available.

subtasks.text: Compare current vs previous run's companies.
Tag new / score-changed items.
Add UI badges + a 'what changed' filter.

items.title: Bring Harmonic + Messari sources live
criteria: With keys, both sources contribute signals to scoring.
Both skip gracefully when keys are absent.
Their contribution is documented and shown in the breakdown.

subtasks.text: Add a Harmonic client + signals.
Add a Messari client + signals.
Feed both into the scorer; show in the breakdown.
Graceful skip + tests for each.

items.title: Hosted demo never errors on missing keys
criteria: The public demo runs end-to-end with zero paid keys.
No stack traces are surfaced to the visitor.
Cold-start latency is acceptable and expected.

subtasks.text: Verify the demo path with all paid keys unset.
Catch + cleanly surface source skips in the UI.
Smoke-test on Render + GitHub Actions.

items.notes: Reverted from done — Render + GitHub Actions smoke test (action item 3) was never actually run. Confirmed both before moving back to review.
